scholarships.name: International English Admission Scholarship
value_texts: Value of award: $7,500 per term ($60,000 over the course of a four-year degree)
eligibility: Be an international student with a valid study permit.
Have a minimum admission average of 80%.
Canadian citizens with dual citizenship (Canada and another country) are not eligible since they already qualify for Canadian tuition rates.
This scholarship is only available to international students who pay international tuition fees. Students paying domestic fees are not eligible.
Remain enrolled full-time in an undergraduate program in one of the following faculties: Arts, Engineering, Health Sciences, Science, Social Sciences or the Telfer School of Management.
renewal_conditions: Frequency of the award: Renewable (maximum 12 instalments)
This scholarship can be renewed for up to 12 instalments if the student meets the renewal criterion:
notes: The published per-term amount, degree total and maximum instalments must be checked against the full terms; do not multiply them automatically.
